_meta.indication: In combination with palbociclib and fulvestrant for the treatment of adults with endocrine-resistant, PIK3CA-mutated, HR-positive, HER2-negative, locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer, as detected by an FDA-approved test, following recurrence on or after completing adjuvant endocrine therapy

pivotal_trials.population: Patients with PIK3CA-mutated, HR-positive, HER2-negative (IHC 0 or 1+, or IHC 2+/ISH-), advanced or metastatic breast cancer, following recurrence on or within 12 months of adjuvant endocrine therapy
pivotal_trials.n: N=325 (Inavo + Palbo + Fulv: 161; Pbo + Palbo + Fulv: 164)
pivotal_trials.result: Median PFS 15 months (95% CI 11.3, 20.5) vs 7.3 months (95% CI 5.6, 9.3) favoring inavolisib + palbociclib + fulvestrant (HR 0.43, 95% CI 0.32, 0.59; p<0.0001); ORR 58% (95% CI 50-66%) for the inavolisib arm

key_safety: Most common (≥ 20%) adverse reactions including lab abnormalities: decreased neutrophils, decreased hemoglobin, increased fasting glucose, decreased platelets, decreased lymphocytes, stomatitis, diarrhea, fatigue, rash, decreased appetite. Hyperglycemia occurred at much higher rates on the inavolisib arm (85%) vs placebo arm (43%). Serious adverse reactions occurred in 24% of patients; permanent discontinuation of ITOVEBI due to an adverse reaction occurred in 6%.
target_moa: Small molecule kinase inhibitor of PI3K with inhibitory activity predominantly against PI3Kalpha; induces depletion of mutant p110alpha; PIK3CA mutations upregulate PI3K pathway activity and are a negative prognostic factor
companion_dx_detail: FoundationOne Liquid CDx (F1LCDx), an NGS-based test to detect PIK3CA mutations in plasma-derived circulating tumor DNA; sPMA P190032-S023 contemporaneously approved as companion diagnostic

advisory_committee.vote: No Advisory Committee was convened for this application.
